cut.v07-bajamonti: Cut: a handsome café-restaurant under the Prokurative arcades, but a room for the square, not for this coast's cooking; the palace lane keeps three kitchens that cook Dalmatia, and the Prokurative is named on the Riva card.
cut.v15-d16-coffee: Moved, not lost: a coffee bar is not a table. It keeps a card under Rooms to linger (its own address and map), and leaves the venue list.
cut.v18-uje-oil-bar: Moved, not lost: an oil shop is not a table. It keeps a card in the larder (its own address and map), and leaves the venue list.
cut.v16-paradox-wine-cheese-bar: Cut on the 23 Oct re-check: listed permanently closed (no closing date found, no 2025-26 trace). Its lane is gone; Zinfandel moves to the bistro lane.
cut.v19-parasol: Cut as a venue: the 23 Oct re-check found it trading as a natural-wine bar, with no trace of the hi-fi system the old guide described; the listening card says so honestly.

v-kantun-paulina.name: Kantun Paulina
v-kantun-paulina.verdict: The reference ćevabdžinica of central Split: skinless minced-meat ćevapi off the charcoal, by five or ten, in a warm somun with kajmak, ajvar and raw onion. Eaten standing or at a few outside tables.
v-kantun-paulina.signature: Ten ćevapi in somun with kajmak and onion.
